items.title: Discovery path reuse benchmarked against exact rebuilds
items.detail: BUILT and RUN, and NOT closed. The gate's own object -- a frozen supernetwork master path set, filtered per candidate -- now exists and was benchmarked against exact rebuilds on 80 preregistered candidates: exact leader identified in 2/5 cases, 120/600 ranking pairs inverted, promoted set changes in 4/5, worst objective rel gap 5.745e-03, median speedup ~5.3x. At survival 1.000 the reuse arm still differs and is BETTER in 4/5 cases, so the residual is enumeration richness rather than filtering, and widening -- the remedy the gate names -- changed nothing. Closure now needs D18's promotion band. This replaces the naive cache-sharing result (worst 1.307), which was a different and invalid object. EXPERIMENT4_MASTERPATH.md, outputs/exp4/masterpath_benchmark.json

items.title: Every ACCEPTANCE.md rejection condition in place before scoring
items.detail: 15 of 15 gates written; scripts/exp4_gates.py executes them: 10 MET, 5 ARMED (they fire on a promoted network and cannot be satisfied before the search), 0 OPEN. Remains MANUAL because 'armed' is a judgement that the right machinery exists, not a proof -- and because D35 showed a constraint can be fully written, validated at construction, hashed into the state digest and still reach nothing that scores
